title: Figure 12: Object Sightings by Number of Objects Seen per Sighting, with Evaluations
description: A central pie chart divides 2199 object sightings by number of objects seen: 1 object (1636 = 74.4%), 2 objects (196 = 8.9%), 3–10 objects (255 = 11.6%), 11 or more objects (66 = 3.0%) and number not stated (46 = 2.1%). Arrows lead to five stacked bars showing the evaluation breakdown ("Per Cent Within Group") for each group, with a legend of Unknown, Others, Insuf. info., Balloon, Aircraft and Astronomical. Caption: "FIGURE 12 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY NUMBER OF OBJECTS SEEN PER SIGHTING WITH EVALUATION DISTRIBUTION FOR EACH GROUP"; drawing A-7490, page 28.
